validation.independentBackendReview: Policy revocation, removed-world cleanup, selected rails/stations/arrivals, mailbox revision fencing reviewed; reported issues fixed and covered by regression tests.

limitations: Simplified train bodies and live route colors; original textures/models/door animations are not reproduced.
Route geometry requires generated MTR depot paths; unresolved legs are omitted.
Station predictions use MTR data, distinguish real-time and timetable-only entries, and show up to eight upcoming trains per station.
Browser verification uses synthetic data; production-world runtime and deployment not performed.
MTR arrivals queries are bounded per platform/siding; exceptionally many private services can exhaust the query limit before some public predictions, which are omitted instead of estimated.
